question: ‘Faster than Lightning - My Story’ is the autobiography of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Usain Bolt__**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Usain Bolt** is a retired Jamaican sprinter, widely considered to be the greatest sprinter of all time.
 
• He is the world record holder in the 100 meters, 200 meters, and 4 × 100 meters relay.
 
• **Faster than Lightning** details the many untold pains and sacrifices an athlete goes through to win that race against the clock.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a2d9d43fed993101b168e9c239492fe8bd50861dcfeb3136b082debe9402081.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Hima Das,__ nicknamed Dhing Express, is an Indian sprinter from the state of Assam. She holds the current Indian national record in 400 meters.
 
• __P.T Usha__ is a retired Indian track and field athlete.** She is ****often called the "Queen of Indian track and field**
 
• Dutee Chand is an Indian professional sprinter and current national champion in the women's 100 meters event. She is the first Indian to win a gold medal in the 100m race.
